neighbours.label: the piece ' fl' opening a word that the tokenizer splits (flub, flunk), as against words without it
fire: The senator made one embarrassing flub at the debate.
That was the worst flub of the night for the anchor.
Many students will flunk the course this year.
If you flunk again, you must repeat the class.
He likes to flout every rule in the building.
They continued to flog the horse up the hill.
The critic had no wish to fleece his readers.
She tried hard not to flummox the new hires.
quiet: The senator made one embarrassing error at the debate.
That was the worst mistake of the night for the anchor.
Many students will fail the course this year.
If you fail again, you must repeat the class.
He likes to break every rule in the building.
They continued to whip the horse up the hill.
The critic had no wish to cheat his readers.
She tried hard not to confuse the new hires.

notes: Card: ' fl' x6, ' Fl' x2, plus broken-byte and ' б' pieces. The - pole is other onsets (' sl', ' y', ' cl'), so this may be a next-token distinction between word beginnings. Probes: 'flub' 0.55-0.68, 'flunk' 0.46, but 'flubbed' 0.07. Flout, flog, fleece and flummox were not probed.
